bug_name: Template CoreVerifyPubkeyG1 does not perform input validation (Simplified)
short_description: This bug is in the circom-pairing BLS signature verification logic. pubkey, signature and hash are divided into 7-entry chunks of 55-bit data, and each entry is checked against according entry in `p`. When calling `BigLessThan()`, the output isn't verified therefore attacker can manipulate the input so that it overflows p.
proposed_mitigation: In each iteration of the for loop, add a constraint `lt[idx].out === 1` to make sure the input is indeed bounded by `p`.

Audit Report.Bug ID: V-SUC-VUL-002: Template CoreVerifyPubkeyG1 does not perform input validation
